On PLUS, the DMS key after a result starts Ans degrees instead of converting the current result. FORMAT changes DMS to exact fraction first, then decimal. Selecting Sexagesimal from the format menu restores DMS. Ans degrees evaluated independently.

DMS input uses degree marks for all entered components while results use degree/minute/second signs. Negative values, addition, fractional seconds and normalization of minutes/seconds beyond 60 measured. 1deg90min90sec becomes 2deg31min30sec.
DMS presentation survives Fix 3 and switching Radian/Grad. MathI and LineI tested. 12.5 converted through FORMAT gives 12deg30min0sec; LineI 2deg15min18sec converts to 451/200.

FORMAT includes Recurring Decimal for eligible fractions, after Decimal and before fraction entries. Native VI label added; English calculation menu uses full Improper Fraction. Dotted cycle delimiters reuse observed native recurring glyphs. 12.58 recurring 2, negative 1/6, 1/7 under Fix 3 and LineI 2/3 measured. FORMAT from recurring gives decimal.
